newsitem.title: AZERBAIJAN: Eleven sentenced for treason in Azeri unrest.
newsitem.headline: Eleven sentenced for treason in Azeri unrest.

text.p: Azerbaijan's Supreme Court said on Wednesday it had sentenced 11 people to long prison terms for involvement in violent unrest in 1995 which the government said was an attempted coup.
The 11 received terms of between five and 13 years for participating in an illegal armed group and possessing weapons.
All the defendants were members of the "OPON" special forces detachment which revolted against the rule of President Haydar Aliyev in March 1995 and demanded his resignation.

The defendants claimed that they were tortured into making false confessions and that the trial was a political spectacle. The process was held over several weeks behind closed doors in the oi-rich former Soviet republic.
